name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
summary: Monthly pension for older people from BPL families.
notes: Apply at the Collector Office, Tahsildar or Talathi. The source page does not list documents, so confirm the list at the Tahsildar office.

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card (AB PM-JAY)
summary: Health cover for every senior citizen aged 70 and above, whatever their income.
documents: Aadhaar card (age is checked from Aadhaar)
notes: Age is the only condition. People already on CGHS, ECHS or Ayushman CAPF must choose one scheme.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
summary: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to 5,000 after age 60.
documents: Savings bank or post office account
notes: Anyone who is or has been an income-tax payer cannot join (since 1 Oct 2022).

name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme
summary: Government-backed savings deposit for senior citizens, at post offices and banks.
documents: Identity and address proof (PAN, passport, voter ID etc.)
notes: Ages 55 to 59 qualify only if retired on superannuation or VRS. Retired defence personnel qualify from age 50.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
summary: Affordable renewable life insurance cover of Rs 2,00,000 for death due to any cause.
documents: Savings bank or post office account details
notes: Available to people aged 18 to 50 having a savings bank account who give consent to join and enable auto-debit on or before 31st May each year.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
summary: Accident insurance scheme offering accidental death and disability cover of up to Rs 2,00,000.
notes: Available to people aged 18 to 70 with an active savings bank account. Annual premium of Rs 20 auto-debited in a single installment.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
summary: Government-backed small savings scheme for the girl child offering high interest and tax exemptions under Section 80C.
documents: Birth certificate of the girl child
notes: Can be opened by biological parents or legal guardians for a girl child from her birth till she attains the age of 10 years. Maximum two accounts per family.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
summary: Direct income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 to all landholding farmer families.
documents: Land ownership proof / Record of Rights (Khasra/Khatauni)
notes: Institutional landholders, income tax payers, and serving or retired government employees are not eligible.
